func L021Event(kind string) {
	if l021Control(kind) != 1 {
		panic("fixture barrier")
	}
}

func l021Control(kind string) byte {
	connection, err := net.DialTimeout("tcp", os.Getenv("FC_L021_EVENTS"), time.Second)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	defer connection.Close()
	connection.SetDeadline(time.Now().Add(15 * time.Second))
	if err := json.NewEncoder(connection).Encode(map[string]any{"event": kind}); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	var reply [1]byte
	if _, err := io.ReadFull(connection, reply[:]); err != nil {
		panic("fixture barrier")
	}
	return reply[0]
}

type l021Packet struct {
	incoming, outgoing chan []byte
	done               chan struct{}
	once               sync.Once
}

func (packet *l021Packet) SendContext(ctx context.Context, data []byte) error {
	select {
	case packet.outgoing <- bytes.Clone(data):
		return nil
	case <-ctx.Done():
		return ctx.Err()
	case <-packet.done:
		return io.EOF
	}
}
func (packet *l021Packet) Recv(ctx context.Context) ([]byte, error) {
	select {
	case data := <-packet.incoming:
		return data, nil
	case <-ctx.Done():
		return nil, ctx.Err()
	case <-packet.done:
		return nil, io.EOF
	}
}
func (packet *l021Packet) Close() error { packet.once.Do(func() { close(packet.done) }); return nil }

func l021Open(ctx context.Context, raw []byte) (*Session, error) {
	L021Event("open")
	if l021Control("bootstrap") == 0 {
		return nil, ErrClosed
	}
	var settings struct {
		Gateway json.RawMessage `json:"gateway"`
		API     string          `json:"api"`
		Mailbox string          `json:"mailbox"`
	}
	encoded, err := os.ReadFile(os.Getenv("FC_L021_FIXTURE"))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer clear(encoded)
	if err = json.Unmarshal(encoded, &settings); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer clear(settings.Gateway)
	api, err := netip.ParseAddrPort(settings.API)
	if err != nil || !api.Addr().IsLoopback() {
		return nil, ErrClosed
	}
	mailbox, err := netip.ParseAddrPort(settings.Mailbox)
	if err != nil || !mailbox.Addr().IsLoopback() {
		return nil, ErrClosed
	}
	forward, reverse := make(chan []byte, 16), make(chan []byte, 16)
	left := &l021Packet{incoming: reverse, outgoing: forward, done: make(chan struct{})}
	right := &l021Packet{incoming: forward, outgoing: reverse, done: make(chan struct{})}
	type result struct {
		secured *familysession.Session
		mux     *tcpforward.Mux
		err     error
	}
	peer := make(chan result, 1)
	go func() {
		secured, err := familysession.OpenMux(ctx, right, settings.Gateway, true, true)
		var mux *tcpforward.Mux
		if err == nil {
			mux, err = tcpforward.NewMux(ctx, secured, true, tcpforward.MuxConfig{MaxStreams: roombroker.DedicatedMaxStreams,
				Policy: tcpforward.Policy{Services: map[string]netip.AddrPort{"chat-api.family-connect.invalid": api, "chat-mailbox.family-connect.invalid": mailbox}}})
		}
		peer <- result{secured, mux, err}
	}()
	secured, err := familysession.OpenMux(ctx, left, raw, false, true)
	if err != nil {
		left.Close()
		right.Close()
		return nil, err
	}
	remote := <-peer
	if remote.err != nil {
		secured.Close()
		return nil, remote.err
	}
	mux, err := tcpforward.NewMux(ctx, secured, false, tcpforward.MuxConfig{MaxStreams: roombroker.DedicatedMaxStreams, WaitForSlot: true})
	if err != nil {
		remote.mux.Close()
		remote.secured.Close()
		secured.Close()
		return nil, err
	}
	L021Event("authenticated")
	go func() {
		if l021Control("peer_control") == 0 {
			remote.mux.Close()
			L021Event("peer_closed")
		}
	}()
	session := Attach(ctx, muxPlane{mux}, func() {
		L021Event("cleanup_entered")
		remote.mux.Close()
		secured.Close()
		remote.secured.Close()
		left.Close()
		right.Close()
		L021Event("cleaned")
	})
	go func() { <-session.ctx.Done(); L021Event("terminal") }()
	return session, nil
}
